title: Reproducible Wasm production toolchain
objective: Build the integrated generated, analytic, number-field, curve, algebraic, M4RI, and source-transparent kernel WebAssembly production closure with deterministic authenticated receipts

oracles: deterministic resolver/receipt fixtures and existing flint-wasm build contract

handoff.summary: Integrated the all-declared FLINT/M4RI generated FFI closure, analytic, number-field, elliptic-curve, public Dirichlet, lazy algebraic, and source-transparent kernel modules into the pinned production build. The build emits five finite-memory Wasm artifacts, 43 authenticated runtime assets, 284 exact capabilities, and a deterministic manifest/receipt with complete C, compiler, bundle, and generated-kernel source closure.
risks: The all-declared FLINT closure is 5.00 MiB uncompressed, so the old proof-of-concept 2 MiB test ceiling must be replaced by the reviewed release payload budget.
Native differential tests require the platform addon to be built in the consuming worktree; browser/Wasm-only specialist tests passed here.
next_steps: Integration should update the old exact-five-resource assertion to the all-declared 11-resource surface and establish the first measured browser payload baseline.
Flip receipt-backed FFI, analytic, curve, algebraic, and complete-kernel inventory records to available, then run the mandatory browser parity/release workflows.
